easyPrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Wild Cantor with haste.
When the Wild Cantor token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate the Wild Cantor token by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
